title: Act: Confirm create stores the transitionTo unsubscribe in unsubscribeTransition
summary: Verify and keep the stored unsubscribe assignment in BootScene.create
description: The code already declares unsubscribeTransition and assigns it in create. Read it and leave it unchanged unless it deviates from the spec; no new behavior is planned.
acceptance_criteria: unsubscribeTransition is assigned the return value of reactToPhaser.on('transitionTo', ...)
The handler fades out then starts the scene on FADE_OUT_COMPLETE

steps.action: Confirm the private field is declared as `private unsubscribeTransition: (() => void) | null = null;` and change nothing if so
steps.expected: Field exists with the nullable function type

steps.action: Confirm `this.unsubscribeTransition = reactToPhaser.on('transitionTo', ...)` assigns the returned function; if the return value is discarded, assign it to this.unsubscribeTransition
steps.code: this.unsubscribeTransition = reactToPhaser.on('transitionTo', ({ sceneId }) => { /* fade then scene.start */ });
